title: Blocks on Grid
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

We have a grid with $H$ horizontal rows and $W$ vertical columns. The square at the $i$-th row from the top and $j$-th column from the left has $A_{i, j}$ blocks stacked on it.

At least how many blocks must be removed to make all squares have the same number of blocks?

## Constraints

- $1 \leq H,W \leq 100$
- $0\leq A_{i,j} \leq 100$

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
H W
A_{1,1} A_{1,2} \ldots A_{1,W}
\vdots
A_{H,1} A_{H,2} \ldots A_{H,W}
```

## Output

Print the minimum number of blocks that must be removed.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

有一个包含 $H$ 行和 $W$ 列的网格。在从上往下数第 $i$ 行、从左往右数第 $j$ 列的方格上，堆叠了 $A_{i, j}$ 个方块。

至少需要移除多少个方块，才能使所有方格上的方块数量相同？

## 约束条件

- $1 \leq H,W \leq 100$
- $0\leq A_{i,j} \leq 100$

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
H W
A_{1,1} A_{1,2} \ldots A_{1,W}
\vdots
A_{H,1} A_{H,2} \ldots A_{H,W}
```

## 输出格式

输出必须移除的方块数量的最小值。

samples.note: Removing $1$ block from the top-right square and $1$ from the bottom-left square makes all squares have $2$ blocks.
